title:
This transform is used to process a `fetchResult` object, typically obtained from a data-fetching operation,
and modify its `fetchSpec` property. This function uses the `extract` utility from the `@c3/ui/UiSdlComponentDataSpecStateParam` module
to generate a new `fetchSpec` object, updating its `id` and merging state as needed.
name: ModelExperimentPreviewFetchSpecTransform
